task.title: Query typed schedule lifecycle history
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/805 by exposing every validated transition for one exact schedule without granting mutation authority.
acceptance_criteria: Return revision-bearing typed creation, cancellation, claim, release, and materialization evidence in stream order.
Preserve exact goal, due instant, reasons, and task identity while returning no history for a missing schedule.
Validate complete decode and lifecycle projection before exposing any prefix.
Keep the query read-only, clock-free, and separate from dispatch, retry, execution, or permission.

attempts.diagnostic: The targeted integration test failed because the typed history event and ScheduleStore::history API did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added full transition-order, exact evidence, missing-stream, malformed-payload, version-gap, and impossible-order tests.

attempts.diagnostic: The latest schedule projection was insufficient for audit and recovery analysis, while exposing raw event payloads would bypass domain validation.
attempts.patch: Reused complete decoding and lifecycle projection before mapping validated events to public typed history entries.

attempts.summary: Aligned history ergonomics with existing kernel precedent.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent and substantive hosted review found no blocking issue in the exact-head history contract.
attempts.patch: Matched workflow-run revision accessors, documented all-or-nothing history semantics, and completed full verification.

outcome.summary: Recovery and audit callers can inspect a schedule's complete validated typed lifecycle without receiving a malformed partial prefix.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test schedule_store

lessons: Expose validated typed history rather than raw storage events when callers need audit evidence.
Project the entire lifecycle before returning entries so corruption cannot produce a plausible partial prefix.
Revision-bearing evidence lets callers reason about exact ordering without granting write authority.
Reuse established history API shapes across aggregates when their contracts genuinely align.
